rows: Oroiael's triad: first member is **Pronoia** (Waldstein–Wisse) vs **Epinoia/Afterthought** (other translations); second = Perception; third = **Memory**
**(2,3) = Memory is stable** across translations; **(2,1) is variant-labeled**. Mneme at position 6 unchanged. Sethian grid remains usable at (2,3) and (4,3), with (2,1) flagged
Irenaeus I.14.5 reports 9+8+7=24 **and** analogical double letters added to reach 30
Any test involving 22/23/24 must carry 30. The Marcosian construction does **not** yield 23; the 30 is a separate analogical extension
